operations.label: Lyse and centrifuge
operations.description: Disrupt the plant cells and fractionate the resulting material, producing a nuclei-containing fraction and a labelled supernatant. The nuclei fraction continues along the depicted workflow.
operations.mechanism: Cell lysis followed by centrifugation; no additional treatment is specified.
operations.information_effect: Transfers chromatin-containing nuclei out of the cellular context while retaining the nuclear compartment for downstream processing.

operations.information_effect: Reduces extraneous cellular material while retaining nuclear chromatin as the substrate.

operations.label: DNase I digestion
operations.description: Digest DNA in the chromatin of the purified nuclei. The nuclear compartment persists during this transformation; yellow symbols indicate the digestion reagent acting on the chromatin.
